design:
## Design tests

Revision 38 and the cast of builder 0.40.0 were read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v040.md`, four pictures, four readers), two of them asking for the goat turned from profile. The reach read one way: "right arm stretched up toward the flying cap, left arm at her side", with no hands thrown up. The hose was held in two hands at the face, "She holds the hose nozzle in both hands, raised toward her face, and seems to be looking into it". The goat ate "a small tuft of grass" with no head lost in it, and "The goat's body is short and hunched, with a small head and long legs. It is still recognisable as a goat". The dry leaves read as leaves, and once, on the street, as "dry autumn leaves, but the tree is fully green".
intro:
The thirty-seventh screen read all 94 pictures, the set's 21 and 73 probes, with twelve readers and four scorers: 1011 of 1014 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. All 64 templates pass the gate, and every (template, angle) the animals are drawn at passes on its own. The blown hat is reached for with one hand, and `windy_hat`, v0.39's one template under the strict count, passes it now in five pictures. No reader loses the goat's head in the grass, reads the pinched hose as a puddle, or calls an ice cream "something small and pink". The heaps' season is v0.41's first item: three drawings of the heap, autumn, green and dry, have each drawn a remark under green trees.

This screen is a retest too: 28 pictures were identical to the pixel in v0.39 and v0.40, and 326 of their 328 items scored the same, the two that moved going up, both on templates of v0.39's list.
screen:
Across all 94 pictures 1011 of 1014 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. The three items under full marks are all in the set: the catcher of the tier-2 garden, "ready to catch the ball or just having thrown it", on a catch v0.39 read in full; the dog on the hose in the tier-4 garden, given only as one of two readings; and the clouds of the tier-3 street's isomorph, a setting item. The set's headline is all items 0.993 (1.00 in v0.39).

**One reader described the wrong picture.** Reader 7 described picture 56's park under picture 55's name, and wrote of picture 56 that it "couldn't find any difference between this picture and pic_55"; its scorer found eleven items of picture 55 at 0. The pictures were distinct and right. Picture 55 was read again by a fresh reader and scored by a fresh scorer, with full marks, and the first description is kept aside (`vision/flaws_v040.md`).

**What the full marks rest on.** The scorers listed 21 items they credited in full where the free description commits and the unsure section adds another reading (11 in v0.39, 23 in v0.38). Halved, 59 of 64 templates pass, with `floating_box` and `play_catch` at 0.833 and `ladder_nothing`, `sweep_fork` and `water_upward` at 0.889; `windy_hat` passes at 0.933.

**An eleventh retest.** 28 pictures, 13 of the set's and 15 probes, were identical to the pixel in v0.39 and v0.40. 326 of their 328 items scored the same; the man sweeping with a giant fork and the dog that wants a walk, v0.39's R3 and R2, moved up by half a mark each, and nothing moved down.

**Remarks were 3.04 a picture, 286 on 94 pictures**, from 2.62 to 3.62 a reader. On the 28 identical pictures they fell from 106 to 93.
redrawn: `windy_hat`, redrawn with a one-hand reach, holds at 1.00 in five pictures and passes the strict count (0.889 to 0.933). `blocked_hose`, the hose in two hands, reads at 0.979 on one half mark that is not about the hands. `goat_grazing`, with its graze and its tuft redrawn, holds at 1.00 at every angle. The heaps, `sweep` and `rake`, drawn of dry leaves, hold at 1.00. `ice_cream`, kept out of the far back, goes from 0.95 to 1.00.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (41 in three, 11 in four, 5 in five, 4 in six, 1 in seven, 1 in twelve and 1 in seventeen), and all 64 pass, as in v0.38 and v0.39. The lowest are `play_catch` (0.917), on one half mark on a picture whose catch v0.39 read in full, and `blocked_hose` (0.979). Per angle (`vision/v040/gate_yaw.json`), all 17 (template, angle) pairs pass, the lowest the hose at 45 (0.938) on the same half mark. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: Every cell of the set placed again on its v0.39 seed and layout under revision 38, the tier-4 street on v0.29 to v0.39's forced set, and the five isomorphs came back as in v0.39. 13 of the 21 pictures are identical to the pixel to v0.39's, and the other 8 differ only where a heap, the goat or the hose is drawn. The probe pass gave `windy_hat` and `dog_wants_walk` five pictures each, the windy hat's last two in the park and the street; the pass stratified by angle filled the begging dog, and 15 of the 73 probes are identical to v0.39's. Every picture was looked at before the screen. All 94 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 392 of 392.
calib: Three fields of the calibration moved by 0.002 or more, all `windy_hat`'s inference, by 0.005 at most.
